cc:Work.dc:description: An eight by eight grid highlights the anti-diagonal from query zero, key seven to query seven, key zero. Input 3 7 7 0 9 1 4 7 becomes 7 4 1 9 0 7 7 3. Saved first-block mean mirror weights are 0.961, 0.932, 0.971, 0.973; the grid is schematic, not an exact heatmap.
